templates.label: Measurement contract
templates.note: Define equal work and acceptance gates before runtime comparison.

templates.label: Equal-work runtime baseline
templates.note: Compare runtime lanes only after model, template and work are fixed.

templates.label: Exact-prefix reuse
templates.note: Declare exact-prefix eligibility and cold/warm cache policy.

templates.label: Speculative decoding
templates.note: Recorded descriptive timing is available for the tested vLLM and SGLang configurations. Exact-output hashes differed and task-specific adjudication remains separate; the public client supports only a synthetic offline rehearsal and accepts no provider configuration.

templates.label: Mixture-of-experts inference
templates.note: Measure conditional computation, expert routing and memory traffic before assuming fewer active parameters mean lower latency. Planned only; verify compatible engine/model paths and local fixture coverage before a paid card. MoE controls require a reviewed engine-specific profile; do not treat architecture as a toggle.

templates.label: Serving tune-up: scheduling and precision
templates.note: Two controlled studies: batching/scheduling first, then attention kernels and precision. Planned only; verify compatible engine/model paths and local fixture coverage before a paid card.

templates.label: Parallelism within one node
templates.note: Two studies on a fixed GPU budget: DP/TP layouts, then MoE expert parallelism and load balance. Planned only; verify compatible engine/model paths and local fixture coverage before a paid card.

templates.label: Multi-node parallelism
templates.note: Network and placement are part of the experiment contract.

templates.label: Disaggregation and routing
templates.note: Executable distributed layouts are outside this planner.

templates.label: Orchestration comparison
templates.note: Platform study; engine controls apply only inside a declared serving arm.

templates.label: Inspectable model internals
templates.note: Companion model study; serving controls are not applicable.

templates.label: LoRA / QLoRA held-out evaluation
templates.note: Companion training study; requires new quality evaluation and lineage.

templates.label: Labeled decision comparison
templates.note: Companion decision study; generation-serving switches may be not applicable.

templates.label: Accelerator and memory preflight
templates.note: Candidate settings require image- and hardware-specific preflight.

templates.label: Saturation and SLO sweep
templates.note: Continuous batching is informational until configuration is verified.

templates.label: Release gate synthesis
templates.note: Retest interactions; no candidate is accepted without all declared gates.
